title: Senior Technical Lead
description:
Senior Technical Lead
Noida, Uttar Pradesh
**Job Summary**
---------------


We are looking for an experienced Pega Technical Architect / Senior CSSA who can design, build, and guide enterprise\-grade Pega applications. The candidate should have strong hands\-on experience in Pega case management, integrations, user interface design — preferably Constellation — security, DevOps, monitoring, and performance optimization.
  

The role requires a strong technical leader who can work closely with customers, business analysts, product owners, architects, and development teams to deliver scalable, maintainable, secure, and cost\-optimized Pega solutions. The candidate should also be aware of the latest Pega platform capabilities such as Pega Blueprint, Process AI, Knowledge Buddy, Pega GenAI Coach, and other AI\-powered features.


**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------


Design and implement Pega applications using best practices, guardrails, reusable components, and enterprise architecture principles.
  

* Own the technical design for case types, workflows, data models, integrations, user interfaces, security model, and background processing.
* Guide and mentor Pega developers in solution design, rule configuration, code quality, guardrail compliance, and troubleshooting.
* Collaborate with customers, business stakeholders, product owners, scrum masters, testers, and other technology teams to translate business requirements into robust Pega solutions.
* Lead technical discussions, design walkthroughs, solution reviews, impact assessments, and architecture review sessions.
* Design and implement Pega case management solutions including stages, steps, processes, assignments, SLAs, routing, correspondence, and exception handling.
* Build and review integrations using REST, SOAP, file listeners, email listeners, queue processors, job schedulers, data pages, and connectors/services.
* Design modern Pega user experiences using Constellation UI, App Studio, views, reusable UI patterns, and responsive design principles.
* Implement Pega security configurations including access groups, roles, privileges, authentication, authorization, data security, and secure integration patterns.
* Support DevOps and release management using Pega Deployment Manager, branch\-based development, CI/CD practices, and deployment governance.
* Monitor application health and performance using Pega Predictive Diagnostic Cloud — PDC, logs, alerts, PAL, Tracer, Clipboard, and other diagnostic tools.
* Perform performance tuning, root cause analysis, technical debt identification, and application optimization.
* Contribute to cost optimization by recommending efficient design patterns, reusable assets, simplified architecture, and optimized use of platform capabilities.
* Support production deployments, go\-live readiness, post\-production validation, and issue resolution.
* Stay current with latest Pega Infinity, Constellation, GenAI, Blueprint, Process AI, Knowledge Buddy, Coach, and related platform capabilities.
* Contribute to reusable assets, accelerators, coding standards, best practices, knowledge sharing, and internal capability building.

Required Technical Skills
  

Core Pega Platform
  

* Strong hands\-on experience in Pega PRPC / Pega Infinity.
* Excellent understanding of Pega case management, case lifecycle design, stages, steps, flows, assignments, SLAs, routing, and correspondence.
* Strong knowledge of rule types such as activities, data transforms, decision rules, when rules, declare expressions, report definitions, data pages, flows, flow actions, and sections/views.
* Good understanding of Pega guardrails, application layering, class structure, ruleset management, circumstancing, and reusable component design.

Pega UI / Constellation
  

* Strong experience in Pega UI design.
* Preferred hands\-on exposure to Pega Constellation UI, App Studio, views, portals, personas, channels, and modern UX design.
* Understanding of traditional UI concepts such as sections, harnesses, skins, dynamic layouts, and Theme Cosmos will be useful for modernization scenarios.

Integrations
  

* Strong experience in designing and implementing integrations using REST, SOAP, connectors, services, data pages, and external systems.
* Good knowledge of integration error handling, data mapping, authentication, retry patterns, and exception management.
* Exposure to file listeners, email listeners, job schedulers, queue processors, and background processing.

Security
  

* Strong understanding of Pega security model including access groups, roles, privileges, access control policies, authentication, authorization, and secure data handling.
* Ability to design secure solutions for enterprise applications involving sensitive or regulated data.

BIX / Reporting / Data
  

* Exposure to Pega BIX for data extraction and downstream reporting.

**Skill Requirements**
----------------------


Good understanding of report definitions, data pages, data types, data transforms, and data modeling.
  

* Ability to design reporting and audit\-friendly data structures.

DevOps and Monitoring
  

* Exposure to Pega Deployment Manager for DevOps, CI/CD, release orchestration, deployment pipelines, and environment promotion.
* Experience with PDC for application monitoring, alert analysis, performance diagnostics, and proactive issue identification.
* Familiarity with Tracer, Clipboard, PAL, logs, alerts, DB trace, and performance troubleshooting tools.

**Other Requirements**
----------------------

title: Lead - Information Security
description:
### **General Information**


Job ID
36794
Location
Noida, India
Work Types
Full Time
Categories
Information Technology  

  

**We never ask for payment as part of our selection process, and we always contact candidates via our corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached for payment, this is likely to be fraudulent. Please check to see whether the role you are interested in is posted here, on our website.**

  

**About TMF Group**
TMF Group is a leading global provider of high\-value business services to clients operating and investing globally. We focus on providing specialized and business\-critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds in different geographical locations.


**TMF India is a Great Place to Work, ISO \& ISAE certified organization.**

  

  

**Discover the Role**
The DLP Operations Lead is responsible for leading the day\-to\-day operation and effectiveness of the Data Loss Prevention service. The role ensures that DLP alerts and incidents are consistently monitored, triaged, investigated, escalated and closed in line with approved procedures and risk priorities. It also provides operational governance, reporting, quality assurance and stakeholder coordination across the DLP lifecycle.


This is an operations leadership role. It does not own routine administration, engineering or technical management of the DLP platform.

  

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Lead daily DLP monitoring and incident operations, ensuring appropriate coverage, prioritisation and workload allocation.
* Oversee alert triage, investigation, evidence review, escalation, containment coordination and case closure.
* Ensure DLP incidents are handled according to approved procedures, severity criteria, service targets and risk\-based priorities.
* Provide guidance on complex, sensitive or high\-risk DLP cases and coordinate required input from relevant business and control functions.
* Maintain operational quality through case reviews, sampling, peer review and coaching of DLP analysts.
* Identify recurring data\-loss patterns, control gaps and process weaknesses, and translate them into clear improvement actions.
* Monitor operational performance, backlog, ageing, escalation quality, false\-positive trends and closure quality.
* Prepare concise operational dashboards, management updates and risk\-based insights for Information Security leadership.
* Maintain and improve DLP operating procedures, playbooks, escalation paths, investigation standards and case documentation requirements.
* Coordinate DLP operational readiness for new or changed policies, ensuring analysts understand the detection intent, expected triage approach and escalation requirements.
* Manage operational hand\-offs with the DLP administration or engineering team where rule changes, platform fixes or technical configuration are required.
* Support audits, control assessments and assurance reviews by providing operational evidence, case records, metrics and process walkthroughs.
* Lead operational reviews following significant incidents and track agreed corrective actions to completion.
* Promote consistent handling across regions while recognising applicable business, legal or regulatory constraints communicated by the relevant owners.

**Team leadership:**


* Provide day\-to\-day direction, prioritisation and subject\-matter guidance to DLP operations analysts.
* Define clear operational responsibilities, shift or coverage expectations, escalation routes and quality standards.
* Coach team members on investigation techniques, evidence quality, stakeholder communication and risk\-based decision\-making.
* Coordinate leave and coverage planning to maintain appropriate monitoring and response capability.
* Foster a collaborative, accountable and continuous\-improvement culture within DLP operations
  
  

**Key Requirements**
**Stakeholder engagement:**


* Act as the primary operational contact for DLP incidents and service performance matters.
* Work with Security Operations, HR, Legal, Privacy, Compliance and business stakeholders according to defined roles and escalation requirements.
* Communicate incident facts, risk, required actions and operational constraints clearly and proportionately.
* Ensure ownership boundaries are clear, particularly where action is required from platform administrators, infrastructure teams or business owners.

**Experience and qualifications:**


* Bachelor’s degree in information security, Cybersecurity, Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Substantial experience in information security operations, including hands\-on involvement in DLP alert monitoring and incident investigation.
* Experience leading or coordinating an operational security team or service.
* Strong understanding of data\-loss scenarios across email, endpoint, web, cloud and collaboration channels from an operational monitoring perspective.
* Experience with incident management, case documentation, escalation, root\-cause analysis and corrective\-action tracking.
* Ability to interpret DLP events in business context and make proportionate, risk\-based decisions.
* Experience producing operational metrics and communicating trends, risks and service issues to management.
* Knowledge of data classification, information handling requirements and relevant security or compliance frameworks.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to handle sensitive matters professionally.

**Core competencies**


* Operational leadership and sound judgement
* Risk\-based prioritisation and decision\-making
* Incident investigation and analytical thinking
* Quality assurance and attention to detail
* Clear stakeholder communication
* Process ownership and continuous improvement
* Confidentiality, integrity and professional discretion

**Success measures:**


* Timely and risk\-aligned handling of DLP alerts and incidents.
* Consistent investigation quality, evidence standards and case closure.
* Controlled backlog and appropriate escalation of high\-risk matters.
* Reduced repeat issues through actionable trend analysis and follow\-through.
* Clear, accurate and decision\-useful operational reporting.
* Well\-maintained procedures, playbooks and team readiness.
* Effective coordination with technical owners without transferring platform administration into the operations role.
  
  

**What’s in it for you?**
**Pathways for career development**


* Work with colleagues and clients around the world on interesting and challenging work.
* We provide internal career opportunities, so you can take your career further within TMF.
* Continuous development is supported through global learning opportunities from the TMF Business Academy.
**Making an impact**


* You’ll be helping us to make the world a simpler place to do business for our clients.
* Through our corporate social responsibility program, you’ll also be making a difference in the communities where we work.
**A supportive environment**


* Strong feedback culture to help build an engaging workplace.
* Regardless of where you are in your career, TMF Group opens a world of opportunity where you will be part of our team and is supported in your global career journey.
* Our inclusive work environment allows you to work from our offices around the world, as well as from home, helping you find the right work\-life balance to perform at your best.
* At TMF Group, it’s our people who make us who we are. Our company thrives on entrepreneurial spirit and is full of proactive people who combine enthusiasm with responsibility and accountability.
**Other Benefits**


* Anniversary \& Birthday Leave policy
* Be part of One TMF
* Paternity \& Adoption leaves
* Salary advance policy
* Work flexibility – Hybrid work model
* Talk about growth opportunities (we invest in talent)
* Well\-being initiatives
  
  

**We’re looking forward to getting to know you!**

* Monitor and analyze security alerts from **SIEM, EDR/XDR, WAF, Firewall, Email Security and Cloud Security** platforms.
* Perform end\-to\-end **incident detection, investigation, containment, eradication and recovery**.
* Investigate security incidents involving **malware, phishing, account compromise, credential theft, suspicious endpoint activity and unauthorized access**.
* Analyze Windows Security Events, authentication logs, network traffic, email headers and other security telemetry.
* Conduct **threat hunting** to identify suspicious activities and potential indicators of compromise.
* Develop and optimize SIEM detection rules, correlation rules and queries to improve detection accuracy and reduce false positives.
* Write and analyze **Splunk SPL queries** for security investigations and threat detection.
* Investigate suspicious PowerShell, command\-line and process execution activity using EDR/XDR tools.
* Analyze **MITRE ATT\&CK techniques** and map observed attacker behavior to relevant tactics and techniques.
* Investigate phishing campaigns using **SPF, DKIM and DMARC** results, email headers and sender infrastructure.
* Investigate suspicious sign\-ins and account compromise in **Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD**, including session and credential\-related activity.
* Analyze **WAF and firewall events** to identify DDoS, brute\-force and credential\-stuffing attacks.
* Support vulnerability and **CVE assessment**, including prioritization based on CVSS and environmental/business context.
* Coordinate with IT, Infrastructure, Network, Cloud and Application teams during security incidents.
* Prepare detailed incident reports, investigation findings, root\-cause analysis and remediation recommendations.
* Maintain accurate incident documentation, evidence and SOC operational records.
* Participate in continuous improvement of SOC processes, playbooks and security monitoring capabilities.

**Required Skills \& Technical Expertise**

* **SIEM:** Splunk or equivalent SIEM platforms
* **EDR/XDR:** CrowdStrike, Microsoft Defender for Endpoint or equivalent
* **Identity \& Cloud:** Microsoft Entra ID / Azure AD and cloud security concepts
* Strong understanding of **Windows Security Events**, authentication and endpoint telemetry
* Strong knowledge of **Incident Response and SOC Operations**
* Knowledge of **MITRE ATT\&CK Framework**
* Working knowledge of **SPF, DKIM and DMARC**
* Experience analyzing **email headers and phishing attacks**
* Knowledge of **WAF, Firewall, DDoS, brute\-force and credential\-stuffing attacks**
* Strong understanding of **IOC/IOA, threat intelligence and threat hunting**
* Experience with **Splunk SPL / SIEM query development**
* Understanding of **CVE, CVSS and vulnerability management**
* Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks, standards and security best practices
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills

**Key Competencies**

* Incident investigation and response
* Threat detection and hunting
* Log and security event analysis
* Security alert triage
* Root\-cause analysis
* Detection engineering
* Risk assessment
* Technical documentation and reporting
* Cross\-functional coordination
* Ability to work effectively in a **24×7 SOC environment**, if required

**Education \& Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in **Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology** or a related field.
* **5\+ years of hands\-on experience** in SOC Operations, Security Operations, Incident Response or Cybersecurity.
* Relevant certifications such as **CEH, CompTIA Security\+, CySA\+, GCIH, GCIA, CISSP, SC\-200** or equivalent will be an advantage.

**What We Are Looking For**

The candidate should be able to demonstrate **practical investigation skills rather than only theoretical cybersecurity knowledge**. Experience should include handling real\-world security scenarios, writing SIEM queries, analyzing logs and headers, investigating endpoint behavior, identifying attack techniques and coordinating appropriate containment and remediation.

The assessment for this role specifically covers **fundamentals, technical depth, scenario\-based investigation, and hands\-on query/log/header analysis**, including phishing and account compromise, EDR investigations, WAF/DDoS analysis, Splunk SPL, email authentication and CVE validation.

Pay: ₹1,000,000\.00 \- ₹2,000,000\.00 per year

* How many experience you have as SOC Analyst?
* What is your Current CTC?
* What is your Expected CTC?
* What is your Notice Period?
